## Pull request

- Make sure the change is not a duplicate of an existing issue or pull request.
- Build it and try it yourself (see the README for the `xcodebuild` command).
- Describe what changed and why. Add screenshots or a screen recording for UI changes.
- Link the issue it fixes with `closes #XXXX` if there is one.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
